pages.text: You've devised a way to forge wolf armor using Cursed Metal. This armor effectively protects your wolf companions, including those you summon, such as Black Wolves and their variants.

You can remove the wolf armor from your wolf using Shears. If the armor is damaged, you can repair it on an Anvil with Cursed Metal Ingots, or simply right-click the armored wolf with a Cursed Metal Ingot in hand, though this repairs less durability.
